name: Set.projIcc
type: {α : Type*} → [LinearOrder α] → (a b : α) → a ≤ b → α → Set.Icc a b
provides: Clip a value into a nonempty closed interval using max a (min b x), returning the clipped value with its bounds.
type_review: Definition and endpoint/inside-interval evaluation rules inspected with linear-order parameters; manually expanded, not compiled.

name: Finset.image
type: {α β : Type*} → [DecidableEq β] → (α → β) → Finset α → Finset β
provides: The finite set of outputs of a function on a finite input set; equal outputs are deduplicated, so an indexed sample should be retained separately when multiplicities matter.
type_review: Definition through toFinset of the mapped multiset and its deduplicated-value and membership rules inspected; manually expanded, not compiled.
